title: Owner returns with Back to Tech View and the row and horizontal scroll positions are restored
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, at a 1150 x 900 viewport, so the default Tech View columns overflow sideways
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List, no layout keys)
Twelve work orders with no lead for a unique customer, each with a line, and the customer has no pinned note

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Tech View, and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View renders, the twelve rows under Unassigned, and the table scrolls both down and sideways

custom_steps_separated.content: Scroll the table down and sideways
custom_steps_separated.expected: Note the first visible row and the horizontal offset

custom_steps_separated.content: Click a plain cell (Number, or another plain cell when Number is scrolled out of view) of a fully visible row

custom_steps_separated.expected:
Tech View renders, data-scroll-restore becomes "applied", and the first visible row and horizontal offset are the ones noted

Back restores Tech View's vertical and horizontal scroll position
